messages:
mai_remote: Hi all 
Hi! I'm starting next Tue remote but planning to fly into SF Wed morning to finish onboarding tasks (I-9, badge, laptop pickup). A few quick asks: can I use a local notary for the I-9 Section 2 or must it be done at the office? My offer included a travel stipend  how do I claim that? Also BG portal shows a missing previous-employer reference  who should I ask for contact details?

dena_peopleops: Welcome, Mai! :wave: Short answers: you can use an authorized agent/notary for Section 2 if you're remote, but since you'll be in SF Wed morning it's simplest to do the verifier check in person at Security. For the travel stipend, file expenses in Concur and tag them "Onboard-Travel"; attach receipts and the approval email. We'll auto-route for payment.

mai_remote: Great. If I do it at Security, what time do they open for new hire verifications? I land at 7:15am and might be at the lobby by 8. Also do I need to bring the paper offer packet or is electronic fine?

dena_peopleops: Security's desk opens at 7:30am on weekdays. Bring passport OR driver's license + SSN card; an e-signed offer is fine. We'll reserve a 8:30am I-9 slot to avoid queues, but if you're earlier Security can process you as well.

ezra_it: FYI laptop is shipping to the office; ETA Tue evening. We'll hold it at Reception if it arrives before you. Bring a photo ID to pick it up. I'll schedule a 9:30am IT drop-in for MFA and account setup. If you want VPN earlier, DM me and we can pre-provision (need scanned ID on file).

mai_remote: Perfect  register me for the 9:30am IT slot. Also BG portal flagged "missing employment verification" for Company X (I used a generic HR email there). Who re-runs that check once I provide a better contact?

hr_bot: Background check status for mai_remote: ACTION REQUIRED  verification attempted at Company X returned no contact. Please provide an alternative HR/email or upload a paystub/offer letter from Company X to speed verification. Ref: BG-9987.

dena_peopleops: Once you upload the document to Workday > Onboarding > Supporting Documents, reply here and we'll trigger a recheck. If you prefer, add the correct HR contact and we'll pass it to the vendor.

mai_remote: Uploaded a Company X paystub and updated the contact to hr@companyx.com. Done. Also I have a question on tax withholding: I moved states recently  do I update my state withholding before first check?

finance_ops: Yes update your resident address and W-4/W-4 state in Workday ASAP. The payroll cutoff for next cycle is 3 business days before pay date; if you miss it we can post a retro adjustment but it's cleaner to update before first run. If you need help filing the state form, ping me and I'll walk you through it.

security_bot: Note for Security desk: reserve temporary badge and I-9 verifier slot for mai_remote at 8:30am Wed. Hold any incoming package addressed to Mai at Reception for pickup. Parking note: provide one visitor voucher for P2 lot.

dena_peopleops: Also adding a quick checklist for you (copy/paste):
``
- Bring passport OR DL + SSN card for I-9 Section 2
- E-signed offer OK, bring printed if you prefer
- Upload any missing BG docs to Workday (you uploaded paystub  good)
- Track laptop delivery; pick up at Reception if early
- File Concur expense for travel (tag: Onboard-Travel) with receipts
- Update Workday address + W-4 before payroll cutoff
- 8:30am I-9 slot + 9:30am IT drop-in scheduled
```

mai_remote: Thanks  quick nit: for Concur, do I need manager pre-approval before booking? Manager approved travel in the offer but I didn't get a separate email.

dena_peopleops: If travel was included in your offer it's pre-approved. In Concur select "Onboard-Travel" and attach the offer email as proof. Payment timeline: first reimbursement via payroll take 1-2 pay cycles depending on cutoffs.

mai_remote: Awesome. One last thing  any childcare/ADA accommodation support if orientation runs long? I might need to step out mid-day.

dena_peopleops: We can absolutely accommodate. Reply here or email people-ops@redwood.ai with details and we'll adjust schedule or provide a lactation/quiet room. We'll note it on your calendar invite.

hr_bot: Reminder scheduled: "Re-run BG for mai_remote" on 08:00 Wed local and "Send welcome packet" at 07:00 Wed local.
